mapper.sql: c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_user_id, c.content, c.status, c.ai_status, c.ip_address, c.create_time, a.title AS article_title, u.nickname AS user_nickname, ru.nickname AS reply_nickname
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cms_comment c LEFT JOIN cms_article a ON a.id = c.article_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = c.reply_user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.id ASC
